cat > build.py << 'EOF'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D
import numpy as np

smiles = ("[Ni](c1ccccc1Cl)"
          "(n2c(/C=N/c3c(C(C)C)cccc3C(C)C)ccc2-c4c(C)cccc4C)"
          "(P(c5ccccc5)(c6ccccc6)c7ccccc7)"
          "(P(c8ccccc8)(c9ccccc9)c%10ccccc%10)")

mol = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smiles)
print("heavy atoms:", mol.GetNumAtoms())
molH = Chem.AddHs(mol)
print("with H:", molH.GetNumAtoms())

ni = [a.GetIdx() for a in molH.GetAtoms() if a.GetSymbol()=="Ni"][0]
nbrs = [n.GetIdx() for n in molH.GetAtomWithIdx(ni).GetNeighbors()]
info = {}
for n in nbrs:
    a = molH.GetAtomWithIdx(n)
    info[n] = a.GetSymbol()
print("Ni neighbors:", info)

# identify donors: N (pyrrole), C (aryl), 2 P
nN = [i for i,s in info.items() if s=="N"][0]
nC = [i for i,s in info.items() if s=="C"][0]
nPs = [i for i,s in info.items() if s=="P"]
P1, P2 = nPs
print("donors N,C,P1,P2:", nN, nC, P1, P2)

# square planar coord map: N trans to C(aryl); P1 trans to P2
coordMap = {
    ni: Point3D(0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
    nN: Point3D(0.0, 1.95, 0.0),
    nC: Point3D(0.0, -1.95, 0.0),
    P1: Point3D(2.25, 0.0, 0.0),
    P2: Point3D(-2.25, 0.0, 0.0),
}
cid = AllChem.EmbedMolecule(molH, randomSeed=42, coordMap=coordMap, coordMapForce=50.0, useRandomCoords=False)
print("embed:", cid)
AllChem.UFFOptimizeMolecule(molH, maxIters=5000)
conf = molH.GetConformer()
pos = conf.GetPositions()

def ang(i,j,k):
    v1 = pos[i]-pos[j]; v2 = pos[k]-pos[j]
    c = np.dot(v1,v2)/np.linalg.norm(v1)/np.linalg.norm(v2)
    return np.degrees(np.arccos(np.clip(c,-1,1)))

print("N-Ni-C:", ang(nN,ni,nC))
print("P1-Ni-P2:", ang(P1,ni,P2))
print("N-Ni-P1:", ang(nN,ni,P1))
print("N-Ni-P2:", ang(nN,ni,P2))
print("C-Ni-P1:", ang(nC,ni,P1))
print("C-Ni-P2:", ang(nC,ni,P2))

# improper / planarity: distance of Ni from plane of 4 donors
d = pos[[nN,nC,P1,P2]]
centroid = d.mean(axis=0)
u,s,vt = np.linalg.svd(d-centroid)
normal = vt[2]
print("donor plane rms out-of-plane:", np.sqrt(((d-centroid)@normal)**2 .mean()), "Ni offset:", (pos[ni]-centroid)@normal)

with open("init.xyz","w") as f:
    f.write(f"{molH.GetNumAtoms()}\nNi pincer complex init\n")
    for a in molH.GetAtoms():
        p = conf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx())
        f.write(f"{a.GetSymbol()} {p.x:.6f} {p.y:.6f} {p.z:.6f}\n")
print("wrote init.xyz")
EOF

content: Found a bug: RDKit was adding implicit H's to each phosphine P (4 bonds → valence model adds H). The correct formula is C67H63ClN2NiP2 (136 atoms). Rebuild with `SetNoImplicit` on P.

args.command:
cat > build3.py << 'EOF'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D
from rdkit.Chem.rdMolDescriptors import CalcMolFormula
import numpy as np

smiles = ("[Ni](c1ccccc1Cl)"
          "(n2c(/C=N/c3c(C(C)C)cccc3C(C)C)ccc2-c4c(C)cccc4C)"
          "(P(c5ccccc5)(c6ccccc6)c7ccccc7)"
          "(P(c8ccccc8)(c9ccccc9)c%10ccccc%10)")
mol = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smiles)
for a in mol.GetAtoms():
    if a.GetSymbol()=="P":
        a.SetNoImplicit(True)
molH = Chem.AddHs(mol)
print("formula:", CalcMolFormula(molH), "atoms:", molH.GetNumAtoms())

ni = [a.GetIdx() for a in molH.GetAtoms() if a.GetSymbol()=="Ni"][0]
nbrs = [n.GetIdx() for n in molH.GetAtomWithIdx(ni).GetNeighbors()]
info = {n: molH.GetAtomWithIdx(n).GetSymbol() for n in nbrs}
nN = [i for i,s in info.items() if s=="N"][0]
nC = [i for i,s in info.items() if s=="C"][0]
P1, P2 = [i for i,s in info.items() if s=="P"]
print("donors:", nN, nC, P1, P2)

coordMap = {
    ni: Point3D(0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
    nN: Point3D(0.0, 1.95, 0.0),
    nC: Point3D(0.0, -1.95, 0.0),
    P1: Point3D(2.25, 0.0, 0.0),
    P2: Point3D(-2.25, 0.0, 0.0),
}
ps = AllChem.ETKDGv3()
ps.randomSeed = 42
ps.SetCoordMap(coordMap)
ps.useRandomCoords = True
ps.maxIterations = 2000
cid = AllChem.EmbedMolecule(molH, ps)
print("embed:", cid)
conf = molH.GetConformer()
pos = conf.GetPositions()
def ang(i,j,k):
    v1=pos[i]-pos[j]; v2=pos[k]-pos[j]
    c=np.dot(v1,v2)/np.linalg.norm(v1)/np.linalg.norm(v2)
    return np.degrees(np.arccos(np.clip(c,-1,1)))
print("N-Ni-C", round(ang(nN,ni,nC),1), "P-Ni-P", round(ang(P1,ni,P2),1),
      "N-Ni-P1", round(ang(nN,ni,P1),1), "N-Ni-P2", round(ang(nN,ni,P2),1))
with open("init2.xyz","w") as f:
    f.write(f"{molH.GetNumAtoms()}\nNi complex init2\n")
    for a in molH.GetAtoms():
        p = conf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx())
        f.write(f"{a.GetSymbol()} {p.x:.6f} {p.y:.6f} {p.z:.6f}\n")
print("wrote init2.xyz")
EOF
